findings: Four registered FDEs cover entry, registration, cache callback and worker.
CIE personality reference is indirect PC-relative to state+0x210; code, LSDA and FDE records remain in the copied text image.
Catch-all landing pads cover Evaluate and the matching native string free.
Entry preserves six argument registers and original stack pointer before tail forwarding.
Registration is checked through the target cache before Evaluate.
limitations: Static review only; runtime acceptance and UI installation are not yet observed.
The target registration helper can allocate when its cache is full and does not check malloc failure.
Native C++ handling does not recover from invalid memory access or unrelated process failures.
Registered code, FDE, LSDA and personality storage must remain mapped until ShellUI exits.
